quotes.text: We shouldn’t be giving tax breaks to massive corporations building data centers in our communities that can drive up energy costs and drain our water supply.

To me, the heart of the data center debate is who decides, and that ought to be the local community [...] If a town decides a project is worth it to land the jobs or increase their tax base, that’s their decision. But if they don’t want one, that should be their decision, too
It’s kind of a Tower of Babel.

AI is on the cutting edge, and what happens is, if people are left to their own devices, they’re going to look at the profit motive before they look at what’s safe and secure for Americans and for the world
